function.name: MPEG_FILTER
function.abstract: It allows to choose the type of filter used to render a video

description.p:
It allows to choose one of the available filters to reproduce a concrete video of the following ones:
0: Without filtering. The video is reproduced, without applying filters.
1: Bilinear filter. This filter smooths to the image mixing adjacent pixels. It is a filter adapted for videos in low resolution.
2: Deblocking. This filter smooths certain defects in the reproduction of videos, without modifying the rest of the image.
By default, the filter activated for any video is the 0 (it is no filter).
